newsitem.title: SPAIN: Vitoria air cargo trafic up 2.4 percent in March.
newsitem.headline: Vitoria air cargo trafic up 2.4 percent in March.

text.p: March cargo traffic at Vitoria airport rose 2.4 percent from the same month last year to 2,324 tonnes, the airport authority said.
This follows an 83 percent increase in February and a 17 percent fall in January and takes the total so far this year to 6,951 tonnes, a 17 percent increase on 1996.
Intercontinental international freight accounted for 1,214 tonnes of the March total, European Union freight for 814 tonnes and domestic cargo only 296 tonnes.
Vitoria started commercial cargo operations in 1994 and showed monthly growth rates of as much as 150 percent last year. It has become an important centre for frozen fish and express package freight.
